zh: 天气卡换成 Three.js 搭的立体窗景：三层楼群与窗灯、湿路面上的车流、雨雪与雷电、塔顶航空灯与扫过的探照灯，镜头缓慢推拉并跟随指针；新增精选库 three，只有声明 libs 的组件才内联它。
en: The weather card now renders a Three.js cityscape: three depth bands of towers with lit windows, traffic on wet asphalt, rain, snow and lightning, rooftop beacons and sweeping searchlights, with a camera that drifts and follows the pointer; a new curated library, three, is inlined only into widgets that declare it.
